comparisonCriteria.materialRegression: candidate median exceeds baseline median by both 20 percent and 5 ms in a matched measurement cell; investigate rather than silently accept
comparisonCriteria.percentiles: No tail percentile claims from 15 healthy or 5 fresh samples; report median/minimum/maximum/range
comparisonCriteria.interpretation: Fresh resident measures resident startup, not cold OS file cache. No universal latency or unmeasured platform claims.

initializationReadiness: Parent elapsed until actual declared executable is observed blocked in arm64 read(0,...), input withheld; 1ms polling adds observation overhead. This proves readiness to consume input, not completion of all initialization or resident readiness.
interleaving: Variants alternate within each round, with order reversed on odd rounds; no excluded warmup samples
fixture: Fresh git repository per installed variant; identical offline Pi before/retire registration protocol, tool edit, no source edit/provider execution. Ready and fresh resident cases separate; exact executable/startticks/lifetime recorded.
environment: Inherited host environment without NODE_OPTIONS, NODE_V8_COVERAGE, REVIEW_* or HAPSLAND_*; perfixture REVIEW_RESIDENT_DIR/STATE_PATH/ACTIVITY_PATH/USER_CONFIG_PATH. No live backend calls. OS file cache uncontrolled; host load recorded.
expectedDuration: 20–40 seconds; finite runner deadline180seconds plus bounded owned resident cleanup
candidateLineage: Root built Linux-arm64 candidate before subsequent source-only runtime-role and native-loader evidence fixes; exact archive identity controls this observation. Later runtime-affecting candidate changes require a new cell.
coordination: Installed conformance worker confirmed all integration processes terminal and holds further runs until benchmark terminal. Root source editing remains active; OS background load remains uncontrolled.
